name: Denyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Denyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing and selling of engine-driven generators, welders, air compressors, and other special machinery in Japan, the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers single phase, three phase, and ultra silence generators; gasoline and diesel welding machines; and box type, trailer type, after cooler type, and dry air type air compressors. It also manufactures and sells industrial electrical machinery and equipment as well as sells related repair parts and after-sales service.
